title: MathTreeChop
description: This is a Minecraft plugin for chopping down trees, featuring entity-based animations designed to closely simulate the animation style of the “Panda’s Falling Tree” mod.
body:
![MathTreeChop Banner](https://i.imgur.com/6bl9O2a.jpeg)

**MathTreeChop** is a highly optimized tree-chopping plugin inspired by *Panda's Falling Tree*, bringing smooth animations and a natural cutting experience to Minecraft servers — without requiring any client-side mods.

---

## 🎬 Showcase

![MathTreeChop Showcase](https://github.com/MatheiderStudios/images-DONT-README/blob/main/cortando_arvore_grande.gif?raw=true)

---

## 🌳 Overview

Break one log, and the entire tree falls with a smooth, physics-like animation.

The real structure is removed instantly, replaced by a fully animated visual tree using `BlockDisplay`, with drops generated only on impact.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🌲 Full tree cutting (single block → entire tree)
- 🎬 Smooth falling animation with impact effect
- 📍 Fall direction based on player position
- ⚡ Performance-friendly (designed to avoid lag)
- 🧠 Smart tree detection system
- ⛏️ Dynamic mining slowdown for large trees
- 🪓 Optional tool durability usage
- 🌐 Multi-language support
- 🎨 HEX, gradient and legacy color support
- ⚙️ **Fully configurable via `config.yml`**

---

## ⚙️ Highly Configurable

Almost every aspect of the plugin can be customized:

- Tree detection rules  
- Animation speed and behavior  
- Mining slowdown scaling  
- Tool requirements and durability  
- Drops behavior  
- Language and messages  

You can fine-tune the plugin to match your server’s gameplay style.

---

## 📦 Compatibility

- **Paper**: 1.21 – 1.21.11  
- **Spigot**: 1.21 – 1.21.11  
- **Bukkit**: 1.21 – 1.21.11  

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar`  
2. Place it in your `/plugins` folder  
3. Restart the server  

---

## 🎯 Why MathTreeChop?

- Feels like a mod, works like a plugin  
- No client installation required  
- Smooth and immersive tree physics  
- Designed for real server performance
